capabilities: Serve HTML files from a local HTTP server so relative assets resolve
Auto-reload the preview over WebSocket when files change
Render the preview in an embedded Obsidian pane via a sandboxed iframe
Toggle between rendered preview and raw HTML source
Open the current preview in the system browser
disambiguation: Not related to Obsidian's Live Preview editing mode; it previews HTML files via a local web server.
extras: Desktop only — the HTTP server relies on Node.js built-in modules. Also installable via BRAT. The README documents security measures (localhost binding, path traversal protection, sandboxed iframe).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to preview HTML files with working relative paths, CSS, JS, and images while editing them.
summary: Live HTML preview that serves HTML files from a local HTTP server with auto-reload, shown in an embedded Obsidian pane or the system browser.
